theme: Open day · kids with Jen · Portland
greeting: A wide-open Friday, Dan — one errand this afternoon and the Black Keys at the State tomorrow. The real pressure today is the overdue to-book pile on the board.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV is still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The p1 on your shared board, overdue since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out — book it refundable now and adjust dates later.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south window is open now
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week gap to drive the Pathfinder Portland to St Pete is live and closes in nine days. Set the dates and book the single hotel night.

needsAttention.title: December trip decision is due
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist was due Sept 30 and the book-by date is Oct 15, six days out. Pick domestic or international-refundable, decide one, and don't shortlist across both.

schedule.title: Haircut
schedule.detail: The only thing on the calendar today.

flagged.title: Heidrick & Struggles board partner wants to connect
flagged.detail: A partner in Heidrick's CEO & Board of Directors practice sent a LinkedIn request — worth a response given the board search.

inbox.noise: A St. Pete local newsletter and routine LinkedIn pings — nothing that needs you.
inbox.clear: The lunch thread with Fran is mid-plan for next Friday; nothing else is waiting on a reply.

resolved.title: The girls' passport run is done
resolved.detail: The passport appointment and the four-kid document packet both got checked off yesterday — the long-tail risk on that is closed.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Autumn squash and cipolline are at their peak now, sweet and rich for roasting.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: Wide open — the best window this week to clear the overdue booking list.
One quick errand downtown breaks up an otherwise free stretch.
Yours, with the Black Keys at the State Theatre tomorrow at noon to look forward to.
